description: A forward support operations officer must approve the next week's waste-handling board for the clinic, administrative offices, and motor pool, specifying each stream's handling location, pickup timing, and required coordination actions.

shared_context.S1: The clinic, administrative offices, and motor pool each generate a separate waste stream that must be removed from the support area next week.
shared_context.S2: Maj. Foster approves the final waste-handling board and any related coordination orders.
shared_context.S3: The support area has a locked medical holding room, a secure document-destruction bin, and a covered hazardous-materials cage.
shared_context.S4: The unit's routine Friday support-services review is used to confirm waste classifications, pickup arrangements, and facility updates before the following week's board is approved.

PF1.text: The clinic's discarded treatment materials must be transferred to the licensed medical-waste contractor at exactly Tuesday 1030, and they must remain in the locked medical holding room until pickup; Lt. Morales received the contractor's confirmation this morning, but the appointment has not yet been added to the support-services board.

PF2.text: The administrative offices' accumulated records are scheduled for secure destruction by the approved shred vendor at exactly Wednesday 1400, and the records must remain in the secure document-destruction bin rather than general recycling; Sgt. Kline received the vendor confirmation yesterday, but the appointment is not yet on the weekly board.

PF3.text: Used oil filters and solvent-contaminated shop rags from the motor pool are classified as hazardous material and must be staged in the covered hazardous-materials cage for the environmental contractor's exactly Thursday 0900 pickup; SFC Rahman completed the classification review this morning, but the updated handling entry has not yet been posted.

acceptance_conditions: Clinic waste must remain in the locked medical holding room until the Tuesday 1030 pickup.
Administrative records must remain in the secure document-destruction bin until the Wednesday 1400 pickup.
Motor-pool oil filters and solvent-contaminated rags must be staged in the covered hazardous-materials cage until the Thursday 0900 pickup.
The board must include a medical-waste contractor coordination action.
The board must include a secure-shred-vendor coordination action.
The board must include an environmental-contractor coordination action.
The secure-destruction scheduling fact must be cited as justification.

content_checks.C2: decisions['medical_pickup_time'] in ['Tuesday 1030', 'Tuesday at 1030', 'Tuesday 1030 next week', 'Tuesday at 1030 next week']
content_checks.C4: decisions['records_pickup_time'] in ['Wednesday 1400', 'Wednesday at 1400', 'Wednesday 1400 next week', 'Wednesday at 1400 next week']
content_checks.C6: decisions['motor_pool_pickup_time'] in ['Thursday 0900', 'Thursday at 0900', 'Thursday 0900 next week', 'Thursday at 0900 next week']
content_checks.C7: any(c['target'] == 'Lt. Morales' and ('Tuesday 1030' in c['detail'] or 'clinic' in c['detail']) for c in commitments)
content_checks.C8: any(c['target'] == 'Sgt. Kline' and ('Wednesday 1400' in c['detail'] or 'administrative' in c['detail'] or 'records' in c['detail']) for c in commitments)
content_checks.C9: any(c['target'] == 'SFC Rahman' and ('Thursday 0900' in c['detail'] or 'motor pool' in c['detail'] or 'hazardous' in c['detail']) for c in commitments)

decisive_facts.why: The contractor confirmation changes the clinic plan to the locked medical holding room and fixes its pickup at exactly Tuesday 1030, requiring the medical-waste coordination action.
The vendor confirmation changes the records plan to the secure document-destruction bin and fixes destruction at exactly Wednesday 1400, requiring secure-shred coordination and citation of PF2.

The hazardous classification changes the motor-pool plan to the covered hazardous-materials cage and fixes environmental pickup at exactly Thursday 0900, requiring environmental-contractor coordination.
